executive_summary: 3 exploratory observation(s) and 3 falsifiable hypothesis/hypotheses were identified. Human review is required.

hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if the candidate fails the predefined out-of-sample acceptance criteria after costs.
hypotheses.hypothesis_statement: A predeclared Wednesday condition may change out-of-sample risk-adjusted return relative to the existing strategy.
limitations: Historical paper evidence may not generalise
hypotheses.proposed_experiment: Compare the unchanged baseline with one predeclared Wednesday filter using walk-forward validation.
hypotheses.rationale: The supporting observation showed an association in 15 completed trades; it is not a causal conclusion.
hypotheses.title: Test Wednesday as a controlled strategy condition
